title: Ordinary sheaf Hom complexes commute with open restriction
statement: Let (X,O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let U be an open of X, and let L and M be arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write res_U for termwise restriction to the localized ringed site over U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. There exists a chain isomorphism Hom^bullet_{O_U}(res_U L,res_U M) ≅ res_U Hom^bullet_{O_X}(L,M), where Hom^bullet is the sheaf-valued Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. No K-injectivity, boundedness, derived categories or resolution choices are assumed.

source.place: Lemma lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U (Tag 08DL), construction of the ordinary Hom complex; sites-cohomology.tex, Section 0A8X

proof.text: For each degree n, the term of the Hom complex is the product over p in Z of Hom(L^p,M^(p+n)) [def-pur-hom-complex]. Restriction to the localized open site is precomposition on sections. Products of sheaves of modules are computed sectionwise, and coverings in the localized site are precisely coverings over that open, so restriction preserves this product. No assertion that infinite products are exact is used.

Use the internal sheaf Hom identification on the localized site [def-pur-sheaf-hom]: on an object V over U the local maps on V are unchanged. The source-library SheafOfModules.overHomObjIso realizes this identification. Apply these isomorphisms to every factor of the product in Step 1; the product universal property gives inverse isomorphisms in degree n.

The factor isomorphisms commute with precomposition by d_L and postcomposition by d_M, since both are compositions of the same local module maps. Restriction is additive and preserves integer multiples. Thus the degreewise isomorphisms identify d_M f - (-1)^n f d_L on both sides [def-pur-hom-complex]. They assemble into a chain isomorphism; take its inverse for the orientation in the Lean statement. Zero complexes, the empty open and arbitrary unbounded complexes obey the same product formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_restrict_open (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (U : Opens X)
    (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U)
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L)
        (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L M))
